title: DistroKid Release Approval Lag
dataSources: Release events (`music:distribution`), Bandcamp activity (`music:bandcamp`), project exports (`music:project`), streaming analytics (`music:streaming`), metadata tasks (`music:ops`).
app: Music-making and creator telemetry — DistroKid release exports, Bandcamp sales activity, Cockos Reaper project stats, and Spotify for Artists analytics — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=music:distribution release_type=* submitted_epoch=* approved_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((approved_epoch-submitted_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by release_type
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures release approval lag by release type for DistroKid release operations.
value: Lag tracking shows which release type create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside DistroKid release operations.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `release approval lag` on `music:distribution` events and aggregate them by `release_type`.
visualization: Table of release type with average and worst release approval lag.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how long things take for each release type so you can see where DistroKid release operations slows down.
